# telnyx_storage_migration_sources (Data Source)

Lists storage migration sources, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_storage_migration_source`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `storage_migration_sources` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_migration_sources))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_migration_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_migration_sources`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket name to migrate the data from.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data migration source.
- `provider` (String) Cloud provider from which to migrate data. Use 'telnyx' if you want to migrate data from one Telnyx bucket to another.
- `provider_auth` (Attributes, Sensitive) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_migration_sources--provider_auth))
- `source_region` (String) For intra-Telnyx buckets migration, specify the source bucket region in this field.

<a id="nestedatt--storage_migration_sources--provider_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_migration_sources.provider_auth`

Read-Only:

- `access_key` (String) AWS Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here.
- `secret_access_key` (String) AWS Secret Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here as well.
